Provide product feedback
In the Security Copilot standalone portal, you can use the following prompt to generate
guided responses:
Generate guided responses and recommendations for Defender incident {incident ID}.
Microsoft highly encourages you to provide feedback to Copilot, as it’s crucial for a
capability’s continuous improvement. To provide feedback, navigate to the bottom of
the Copilot side panel and select the feedback icon
.
